about: Perturbation hints of the tag perturbation check (docs/tag-applied-check.md), keyed by Class/tag path: perturb (auto, scale:<f>, flip, drop, set:<value>) or skip (why it cannot be checked headless). Rows without a hint use auto.

SpaceUnit/Layer_Z_Adjust.why: the M2 craft do not author it (their height is the default); set: gives every checked object one
